attempts.summary: Published node2's HTTP service (port 8080) on node1's (OPNsense) LAN address port 80 via a port-forward with NAT reflection (Pure NAT), plus a manual outbound source-NAT rule so hairpinned traffic to node2 arrives sourced as node1's own IP. node2's firewalld only accepts port 8080 from node1's address, forcing node3 to reach the service through http://10.100.9.10:80/ rather than hitting node2:8080 directly (which is rejected). All three nodes were then restarted one at a time per the mandatory protocol, with boot-identity changes confirmed and full service/NAT/firewall recovery verified after each.
